payload.reason: The evidence provides specific hyperparameters that are explored in the context of NLP tasks, particularly related to word2vec.

claims.text: The hyperparameters explored include vector dimension size, type of algorithm, learning rate, architecture, subsampling rate, and window size.
Optimal combinations of word2vec hyperparameters are determined for intrinsic and extrinsic evaluation tasks.
Different research involving word2vec has used various hyperparameter combinations, many of which may be sub-optimal.
